Disburse Cash Transfer To Beneficiary.description: Sends a single bank transfer, e.g. a cash-transfer payment to a programme beneficiary.

Reserve Account For Customer.description: Creates a dedicated virtual account so payments from one payer or facility are traced automatically.

Get Transfer Status.description: Checks whether a disbursement succeeded, using the reference sent when it was initiated.

Search Disbursements For Reconciliation.description: Lists all disbursements from a wallet in a date range; list() pages through every result.

Search Collection Transactions.description: Fetches incoming payments, e.g. to reconcile premiums or fees against a CRM or ERP.

Get Reserved Account.description: Reads a reserved account's details and bank account numbers.
Get Reserved Account.code:
// Get a reserved account by your account reference.
get(`/api/v2/bank-transfer/reserved-accounts/${$.data.memberId}`);
